+def _direct_free_distance(
+    a,
+    b,
+):
+    if (
+        a is None
+        or
+        b is None
+    ):
+        return float("inf")
+
+    return float(
+        math.hypot(
+            float(a[0]) - float(b[0]),
+            float(a[1]) - float(b[1]),
+        )
+    )
+
+
+class InsertionDirectFreeTracker:
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        camera,
+    ):
+        self.camera = str(
+            camera
+        )
+
+        self.filtered_uv = None
+
+        self.history = (
+            collections.deque(
+                maxlen=
+                    INSERTION_DIRECT_FREE_MEDIAN_WINDOW
+            )
+        )
+
+        self.last_measurement_time = 0.0
+
+        self.reacquire_uv = None
+        self.reacquire_count = 0
+
+
+    def reset(
+        self,
+    ):
+        self.filtered_uv = None
+        self.history.clear()
+
+        self.last_measurement_time = 0.0
+
+        self.reacquire_uv = None
+        self.reacquire_count = 0
+
+
+    def _result(
+        self,
+        source,
+        state,
+        uv,
+        raw_uv=None,
+        jump_px=None,
+        identity_margin_px=None,
+        endpoints_uv=None,
+        measurement_timestamp=None,
+    ):
+        return {
+            "uv":
+                (
+                    tuple(
+                        float(x)
+                        for x in uv
+                    )
+                    if uv is not None
+                    else None
+                ),
+
+            "source":
+                source,
+
+            "direct_state":
+                str(state),
+
+            "direct_raw_uv":
+                (
+                    list(
+                        raw_uv
+                    )
+                    if raw_uv is not None
+                    else None
+                ),
+
+            "direct_filtered_uv":
+                (
+                    list(
+                        self.filtered_uv
+                    )
+                    if self.filtered_uv is not None
+                    else None
+                ),
+
+            "direct_jump_px":
+                (
+                    float(
+                        jump_px
+                    )
+                    if jump_px is not None
+                    and np.isfinite(
+                        jump_px
+                    )
+                    else None
+                ),
+
+            "direct_identity_margin_px":
+                (
+                    float(
+                        identity_margin_px
+                    )
+                    if identity_margin_px is not None
+                    and np.isfinite(
+                        identity_margin_px
+                    )
+                    else None
+                ),
+
+            "direct_reacquire_uv":
+                (
+                    list(
+                        self.reacquire_uv
+                    )
+                    if self.reacquire_uv is not None
+                    else None
+                ),
+
+            "direct_reacquire_count":
+                int(
+                    self.reacquire_count
+                ),
+
+            "direct_endpoints_uv":
+                (
+                    [
+                        list(
+                            p
+                        )
+                        for p in endpoints_uv
+                    ]
+                    if endpoints_uv is not None
+                    else None
+                ),
+
+            "measurement_timestamp":
+                (
+                    float(
+                        measurement_timestamp
+                    )
+                    if measurement_timestamp is not None
+                    else None
+                ),
+        }
+
+
+    def _temporary_loss(
+        self,
+        now,
+        state,
+        raw_uv=None,
+        jump_px=None,
+        identity_margin_px=None,
+        endpoints_uv=None,
+    ):
+        age = float("inf")
+
+        if self.last_measurement_time > 0.0:
+            age = (
+                float(now)
+                -
+                self.last_measurement_time
+            )
+
+        if (
+            self.filtered_uv is not None
+            and
+            0.0
+            <=
+            age
+            <=
+            INSERTION_DIRECT_FREE_HOLD_S
+        ):
+            return self._result(
+                "MEASURED_HOLD",
+                state,
+                self.filtered_uv,
+                raw_uv=raw_uv,
+                jump_px=jump_px,
+                identity_margin_px=
+                    identity_margin_px,
+                endpoints_uv=endpoints_uv,
+                measurement_timestamp=
+                    self.last_measurement_time,
+            )
+
+        if self.filtered_uv is not None:
+            return self._result(
+                "DISPLAY_ONLY",
+                state,
+                self.filtered_uv,
+                raw_uv=raw_uv,
+                jump_px=jump_px,
+                identity_margin_px=
+                    identity_margin_px,
+                endpoints_uv=endpoints_uv,
+                measurement_timestamp=
+                    self.last_measurement_time,
+            )
+
+        return self._result(
+            None,
+            state,
+            None,
+            raw_uv=raw_uv,
+            jump_px=jump_px,
+            identity_margin_px=
+                identity_margin_px,
+            endpoints_uv=endpoints_uv,
+            measurement_timestamp=None,
+        )
+
+
+    def update(
+        self,
+        path_mask,
+        reference_uv,
+        now,
+    ):
+        try:
+            path = np.asarray(
+                path_mask,
+                dtype=bool,
+            )
+
+        except Exception:
+            path = None
+
+        if (
+            path is None
+            or
+            not np.any(
+                path
+            )
+        ):
+            return self._temporary_loss(
+                now,
+                "NO_RAW_PATH",
+            )
+
+
+        try:
+            ordered = (
+                grasp.manual.
+                ordered_path_from_mask(
+                    path
+                )
+            )
+
+        except Exception:
+            ordered = None
+
+
+        if (
+            ordered is None
+            or
+            len(
+                ordered
+            )
+            < 2
+        ):
+            return self._temporary_loss(
+                now,
+                "NO_ORDERED_PATH",
+            )
+
+
+        e0_yx = ordered[0]
+        e1_yx = ordered[-1]
+
+        endpoints_uv = (
+            (
+                float(
+                    e0_yx[1]
+                ),
+                float(
+                    e0_yx[0]
+                ),
+            ),
+            (
+                float(
+                    e1_yx[1]
+                ),
+                float(
+                    e1_yx[0]
+                ),
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+        # Use our current direct track whenever available.
+        identity_reference = (
+            self.filtered_uv
+            if self.filtered_uv is not None
+            else reference_uv
+        )
+
+        if identity_reference is None:
+            return self._temporary_loss(
+                now,
+                "NEED_FREE_REFERENCE",
+                endpoints_uv=endpoints_uv,
+            )
+
+
+        d0 = _direct_free_distance(
+            endpoints_uv[0],
+            identity_reference,
+        )
+
+        d1 = _direct_free_distance(
+            endpoints_uv[1],
+            identity_reference,
+        )
+
+        if d0 <= d1:
+            candidate = endpoints_uv[0]
+            nearest_distance = d0
+        else:
+            candidate = endpoints_uv[1]
+            nearest_distance = d1
+
+
+        identity_margin = abs(
+            d0 - d1
+        )
+
+
+        # If both ends are similarly plausible, do not allow
+        # FREE/FIXED identity to flip.
+        if (
+            identity_margin
+            <
+            INSERTION_DIRECT_FREE_IDENTITY_MARGIN_PX
+        ):
+            return self._temporary_loss(
+                now,
+                "IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS",
+                raw_uv=candidate,
+                jump_px=nearest_distance,
+                identity_margin_px=
+                    identity_margin,
+                endpoints_uv=endpoints_uv,
+            )
+
+
+        # First trustworthy direct measurement.
+        if self.filtered_uv is None:
+
+            self.filtered_uv = (
+                float(
+                    candidate[0]
+                ),
+                float(
+                    candidate[1]
+                ),
+            )
+
+            self.history.clear()
+            self.history.append(
+                self.filtered_uv
+            )
+
+            self.last_measurement_time = (
+                float(now)
+            )
+
+            self.reacquire_uv = None
+            self.reacquire_count = 0
+
+            return self._result(
+                "MEASURED",
+                "LIVE_INIT",
+                self.filtered_uv,
+                raw_uv=candidate,
+                jump_px=nearest_distance,
+                identity_margin_px=
+                    identity_margin,
+                endpoints_uv=endpoints_uv,
+                measurement_timestamp=
+                    self.last_measurement_time,
+            )
+
+
+        jump_px = (
+            _direct_free_distance(
+                candidate,
+                self.filtered_uv,
+            )
+        )
+
+        normal_jump = float(
+            INSERTION_DIRECT_FREE_NORMAL_JUMP_PX[
+                self.camera
+            ]
+        )
+
+
+        # ====================================================
+        # Normal continuous tracking.
+        # ====================================================
+
+        if jump_px <= normal_jump:
+
+            self.reacquire_uv = None
+            self.reacquire_count = 0
+
+            self.history.append(
+                (
+                    float(
+                        candidate[0]
+                    ),
+                    float(
+                        candidate[1]
+                    ),
+                )
+            )
+
+            arr = np.asarray(
+                list(
+                    self.history
+                ),
+                dtype=np.float64,
+            )
+
+            median_uv = np.median(
+                arr,
+                axis=0,
+            )
+
+            alpha = float(
+                INSERTION_DIRECT_FREE_EMA_ALPHA[
+                    self.camera
+                ]
+            )
+
+            self.filtered_uv = (
+                (
+                    1.0 - alpha
+                )
+                *
+                float(
+                    self.filtered_uv[0]
+                )
+                +
+                alpha
+                *
+                float(
+                    median_uv[0]
+                ),
+                (
+                    1.0 - alpha
+                )
+                *
+                float(
+                    self.filtered_uv[1]
+                )
+                +
+                alpha
+                *
+                float(
+                    median_uv[1]
+                ),
+            )
+
+            self.last_measurement_time = (
+                float(now)
+            )
+
+            return self._result(
+                "MEASURED",
+                "LIVE",
+                self.filtered_uv,
+                raw_uv=candidate,
+                jump_px=jump_px,
+                identity_margin_px=
+                    identity_margin,
+                endpoints_uv=endpoints_uv,
+                measurement_timestamp=
+                    self.last_measurement_time,
+            )
+
+
+        # ====================================================
+        # Large jump:
+        # do NOT permanently reject it.
+        #
+        # Require a spatially coherent candidate for 3
+        # consecutive visual updates, then re-anchor.
+        # ====================================================
+
+        if self.reacquire_uv is None:
+
+            self.reacquire_uv = (
+                float(
+                    candidate[0]
+                ),
+                float(
+                    candidate[1]
+                ),
+            )
+
+            self.reacquire_count = 1
+
+        else:
+
+            candidate_cluster_error = (
+                _direct_free_distance(
+                    candidate,
+                    self.reacquire_uv,
+                )
+            )
+
+            if (
+                candidate_cluster_error
+                <=
+                INSERTION_DIRECT_FREE_REACQUIRE_CLUSTER_PX
+            ):
+                n = (
+                    self.reacquire_count
+                    +
+                    1
+                )
+
+                old = (
+                    self.reacquire_uv
+                )
+
+                self.reacquire_uv = (
+                    (
+                        float(
+                            old[0]
+                        )
+                        *
+                        self.reacquire_count
+                        +
+                        float(
+                            candidate[0]
+                        )
+                    )
+                    /
+                    n,
+                    (
+                        float(
+                            old[1]
+                        )
+                        *
+                        self.reacquire_count
+                        +
+                        float(
+                            candidate[1]
+                        )
+                    )
+                    /
+                    n,
+                )
+
+                self.reacquire_count = n
+
+            else:
+
+                self.reacquire_uv = (
+                    float(
+                        candidate[0]
+                    ),
+                    float(
+                        candidate[1]
+                    ),
+                )
+
+                self.reacquire_count = 1
+
+
+        if (
+            self.reacquire_count
+            >=
+            INSERTION_DIRECT_FREE_REACQUIRE_UPDATES
+        ):
+
+            self.filtered_uv = (
+                float(
+                    self.reacquire_uv[0]
+                ),
+                float(
+                    self.reacquire_uv[1]
+                ),
+            )
+
+            self.history.clear()
+            self.history.append(
+                self.filtered_uv
+            )
+
+            self.last_measurement_time = (
+                float(now)
+            )
+
+            self.reacquire_uv = None
+            self.reacquire_count = 0
+
+            return self._result(
+                "MEASURED",
+                "REACQUIRED",
+                self.filtered_uv,
+                raw_uv=candidate,
+                jump_px=jump_px,
+                identity_margin_px=
+                    identity_margin,
+                endpoints_uv=endpoints_uv,
+                measurement_timestamp=
+                    self.last_measurement_time,
+            )
+
+
+        # Show the new candidate while robot motion is stopped.
+        return self._result(
+            "REACQUIRE",
+            "REACQUIRE",
+            self.reacquire_uv,
+            raw_uv=candidate,
+            jump_px=jump_px,
+            identity_margin_px=
+                identity_margin,
+            endpoints_uv=endpoints_uv,
+            measurement_timestamp=
+                self.last_measurement_time
+                if self.last_measurement_time > 0.0
+                else None,
+        )
+
+
+def draw_insertion_direct_free_status(
+    image,
+    info,
+):
+
+    if not isinstance(
+        info,
+        dict,
+    ):
+        return image
+
+    state = info.get(
+        "direct_state"
+    )
+
+    if not state:
+        return image
+
+    source = info.get(
+        "source"
+    )
+
+    if source == "MEASURED":
+        color = (0, 255, 0)
+
+    elif source == "REACQUIRE":
+        color = (0, 165, 255)
+
+    elif source == "MEASURED_HOLD":
+        color = (0, 255, 255)
+
+    else:
+        color = (0, 0, 255)
+
+
+    jump = info.get(
+        "direct_jump_px"
+    )
+
+    margin = info.get(
+        "direct_identity_margin_px"
+    )
+
+    count = int(
+        info.get(
+            "direct_reacquire_count",
+            0,
+        )
+        or 0
+    )
+
+
+    line1 = (
+        f"DIRECT FREE: {state} "
+        f"source={source}"
+    )
+
+    line2 = (
+        "jump="
+        +
+        (
+            f"{jump:.1f}px"
+            if jump is not None
+            else "NA"
+        )
+        +
+        " margin="
+        +
+        (
+            f"{margin:.1f}px"
+            if margin is not None
+            else "NA"
+        )
+        +
+        f" reacq={count}/"
+        f"{INSERTION_DIRECT_FREE_REACQUIRE_UPDATES}"
+    )
+
+
+    cv2.putText(
+        image,
+        line1,
+        (12, 226),
+        cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,
+        0.42,
+        color,
+        1,
+        cv2.LINE_AA,
+    )
+
+    cv2.putText(
+        image,
+        line2,
+        (12, 246),
+        cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX,
+        0.40,
+        color,
+        1,
+        cv2.LINE_AA,
+    )
+
+    return image
+

+def insertion_axis_command(
+    error_px,
+    kp,
+    sign,
+):
+    """
+    Fine insertion-only controller.
+
+    GRASP keeps its existing 4 px deadband.
+    INSERTION uses only a 0.5 px deadband.
+    """
+
+    if (
+        error_px is None
+        or
+        not np.isfinite(
+            error_px
+        )
+    ):
+        return 0.0
+
+    error_px = float(
+        error_px
+    )
+
+    if (
+        abs(
